name: firedrill
description: Set up Firedrill and run simulations of your AI agent with synthetic users, tools and scenarios.

interface.shortDescription: Simulate your AI agent before production
interface.longDescription: Instructions for coding agents to set up Firedrill, register the user's AI agent, build its synthetic world, run drills on the user's machine and read the reports. The skill contains instructions only: no credentials, MCP server or runtime. Drills need the Firedrill CLI (npm package firedrill-run); the remote MCP server at https://mcp.firedrill.run is optional.
defaultPrompt: Use Firedrill to simulate the agent in this repository. Show me the plan before running anything.
